sentences.text: Cooper, a 6-year-old neutered male Labrador Retriever, is on day 46 of 56 of an owner-entered Royal Canin HP trial since May 18, and chicken appears on 29 of 154 meals and treats during it, with at least 4 off-list, the last Jun 27.
Dentastix, whose label lists chicken, is given daily from Jun 8 as an item on the owner-entered allowed list, and no chicken-free day is recorded since Jun 8.

Itching has 16 entries on 16 of 43 logged days over at least 35 days and is not a test of the diet: Apoquel 16 mg once daily, doses not logged, and NexGard from Jun 5 and Dentastix from Jun 8 overlap the trial.
The NexGard 68 mg chews on Jun 5 and Jul 2 have flavour protein unknown and are not counted off-list.
